answer: Locks are logged in pearl, expire in grove, and juniper lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 22 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Someone running 35 aliases therefore needs 178 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 2948 identities would post 1153 proofs and burn roughly 80 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
